Task: Managed NoSQL Document Store

Write Python code that applies a conditional or version-aware update to one stored document using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from motor.motor_asyncio import AsyncIOMotorClient

app = FastAPI()

# Connect to MongoDB Atlas
client = AsyncIOMotorClient("mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@cluster0.mongodb.net/myFirstDatabase?retryWrites=true&w=majority")
db = client["myFirstDatabase"]
collection = db["myFirstCollection"]

class Document(BaseModel):
    id: str
    content: str

@app.post("/update-document")
async def update_document(document: Document):
    document_id = document.id
    new_content = document.content

    # Apply conditional update
    try:
        await collection.update_one(
            {"_id": document_id},
            {"$set": {"content": new_content}},
            upsert=False,
            bypass_document_validation=False,
            collation=None,
            array_filters=None,
